title: MicroG: Free-libre re-implementation of Google's proprietary Android user space
summary: MicroG is a free-libre open-source re-implementation of Google's proprietary Android user space components, primarily Google Play Services, allowing Android devices to function without Google's closed-source framework.
problem_solved: Enables Android users to avoid Google's proprietary services while still using apps that depend on Google Play Services, addressing privacy and freedom concerns.
why_valuable: It empowers users with privacy, digital freedom, and the ability to de-google their Android experience without losing functionality in apps requiring Google services.
